propositions: Only a P8 too-big DET block currently short-circuits the plan review; P1/P5 DET blocks still proceed to the full LLM review.
A plan failing the blocking clarity floor pays for a four-pass LLM review it is guaranteed to fail.
The short-circuit branch should widen from P8-only to any DET gate producing a blocking finding, reusing partition_findings/finalize_verdict.
Any DET-floor blocking finding should yield a BLOCK verdict with coverage.llm_ran False and zero finder invocations.
DET-passing plans must still run the full LLM passes unchanged.
The short-circuit BLOCK verdict must carry every DET blocking finding with standard remediation text.
